title: Iran expands attacks on Gulf states after intense US strikes
facts: Iran and the United States exchanged military fire for the third time in a single week over control of the Strait of Hormuz.
The 2026 war between the United States and Iran began with surprise US-Israeli strikes on February 28.
The crew of a commercial ship in the Strait of Hormuz abandoned the vessel after an Iranian attack caused it to catch fire.
Iran's Revolutionary Guards declared the Strait of Hormuz closed until the end of American interventions in the region.
The US military's Central Command asserted that the Strait of Hormuz remained open to all vessels seeking lawful transit.
Iranian state media reported that at least 10 enemy projectiles hit Qeshm Island on the Strait of Hormuz on Sunday evening.
Iranian state media reported strikes on the island of Farur that killed a telecommunications worker and wounded two others.
Kuwait reported damage to three land border posts in the north following an attack.
An offshore drilling platform in Kuwait was targeted by a hostile drone, resulting in one injury.
The US military stated it responded to Iranian actions with strikes on approximately 140 targets.
One Iranian soldier was reportedly killed in the southern city of Jask during the US strikes.
The Jordanian government stated that three Iranian missiles fell inside its territory.
Oman summoned the Iranian ambassador and issued a formal protest after Iran's Revolutionary Guards struck Omani territory.
An Iranian attack on a Cyprus-flagged container ship in the Strait of Hormuz left one Indian sailor missing.
Omani authorities rescued 23 crew members from a commercial ship approximately 17 kilometers east of Oman.
